decisions.reason: The industrial AC voltage input module has its own page and supports the firm's push into industrial automation and energy monitoring, so it stays strategically relevant.
A four-channel solid state relay is a core control building block with low maintenance cost, though it could later be replaced by a version with the newer connector.
The server room kit bundles existing modules at low marginal cost, but as a kit it is the most exposed to rationalisation during the platform's connector transition.
The RGB LED control module is newly launched, fits the modular platform and is cheap to keep available from in-house production.
The remote access service supports the firm's growing wallbox and energy-management line, where recurring software services add value to the strategic direction.
